**Observations from the image:**
- Sugarcane leaf with a prominent white/cream-colored stripe running longitudinally along the lower half of the leaf
- A distinct reddish spot/lesion visible within the white stripe area
- Upper portion of the leaf remains green
- The white stripe runs parallel to the leaf veins

**Matching against symptom descriptions:**

- **Leaf_Scald** is the clear match: "white pencil line (1-2 mm wide) extending from midrib to leaf margin parallel to veins, diffuse yellow border, **reddish discoloration along the pencil line**" — the white longitudinal stripe with the red lesion spot is the hallmark symptom of Leaf Scald.
- Other candidates (Mosaic, Streak, Yellow Leaf, Grassy Shoot, Pokkah Boeng) show mosaic patterns, yellowing, or structural deformities — none match the white stripe + reddish discoloration pattern seen here.
